lines.text: Polly the colorful parrot loved exercising her vocal cords at maximum volume!
She flew into the cozy public library and squawked, HELLO EVERYONE, LOOK AT MY FEATHERS!
Ears hurt, books rattled, and sleeping baby squirrels woke up crying in fright!
Librarian Owl held up a gentle wing and explained the difference between voice spaces!
The wide open playground is for booming cheering, shouting goals, and loud laughter!
Inside cozy rooms, gentle voices protect people's focus and create peaceful spaces!
Polly leaned in and practiced her warm, gentle whisper voice: Want to read together?
Knowing when to be quiet and when to be loud shows respect for everyone around you!
Use your gentle voice and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
